frontierhunts.lw.book.camplog.1:
DEER CAMP LOG

Opening morning. Frost on the tents, fog in the bottoms. Three of us on stands before first light.
frontierhunts.lw.book.camplog.2:
Day 2
Saw does all morning, one small buck chasing. Wind swirled in the afternoon. Spooked a big one off the field edge.
frontierhunts.lw.book.camplog.3:
Day 4
Rattled one in at noon of all times. Clean shot, short track. He is on the pole now, a fine eight.
frontierhunts.lw.book.camplog.4:
Last day
Cold front coming. Pack the tents dry if you can. Whoever finds this: the camp post is yours to claim. Good hunting.
frontierhunts.lw.book.camplog.title: Deer Camp Log

frontierhunts.lw.book.lastentries.1:
Oct. 3
Set up on the bench above the creek. Good water, good sign everywhere. Elk bugling all night.
frontierhunts.lw.book.lastentries.2:
Oct. 6
Bear in camp at 2 am. Banged pots till it left. Moved the meat pole farther out.
frontierhunts.lw.book.lastentries.3:
Oct. 9
Snow. A lot of it. Can't see the ridge. Fire won't keep. We'll try for the post at first light.

frontierhunts.lw.book.rangerlog.1:
RANGER STATION LOGBOOK

Welcome to the reserve. New hunters: take a Frontier Handbook from the box by the door. It walks you through everything.
frontierhunts.lw.book.rangerlog.2:
CHECK-IN
Bring every harvest here to be weighed and recorded. The big-buck board out front keeps the season's best.
frontierhunts.lw.book.rangerlog.3:
SAFETY
Know what is behind your target. Wear orange during rifle season. Tell someone where you are hunting.
frontierhunts.lw.book.rangerlog.4:
NOTES
Bear seen near the north creek. Elk moving down from the high basin. Duck flights heavy at the marsh at dawn.

frontierhunts.lw.book.elkcamp.1:
ELK CAMP

Rode in four hours from the trailhead. Wall tents up by dark, stove going. Cold and clear.
frontierhunts.lw.book.elkcamp.2:
Day 2
Bugled from the saddle at first light. Three bulls answered. Closed to 300 yards but the wind turned.
frontierhunts.lw.book.elkcamp.3:
Day 3
Big six-point in the meadow at last light. One shot. Quartered him by lantern, mules packed at dawn.
frontierhunts.lw.book.elkcamp.4:
Day 5
Snow coming. Breaking camp. Leave the hay for whoever comes next.
